# CodeXCareer

> All-in-one placement and tech career platform for students and developers.

CodeXCareer combines campus placement preparation, ATS resume scoring, AI mock interviews, coding practice, job hunt, and a tech project marketplace.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://codexcareer.com/): Product overview
- [Placement preparation](https://codexcareer.com/placement-preparation): Campus placement platform pillar
- [ATS resume builder](https://codexcareer.com/ats-resume-builder): ATS scoring and resume tools
- [AI mock interview](https://codexcareer.com/ai-mock-interview): AI interview practice
- [Pricing](https://codexcareer.com/pricing): INR plans (Monthly ₹299, Yearly ₹699, Lifetime ₹999)
- [About](https://codexcareer.com/about): Organization and mission
- [FAQ](https://codexcareer.com/faq): Common questions
